rationale: The agent located a user by name and ZIP and retrieved user/order/product details, but then executed an exchange (exchange_delivered_order_items) without first obtaining explicit user confirmation. The policy requires confirmation before any order-changing write. Additionally, the agent did not present or confirm that the selected replacement is the maximum size, nor provide final details about the exchange (costs, return/shipping steps, confirmation numbers). While the tools suggest the action pertained to the presumed user, the lack of confirmation and missing final information violate the policy. Therefore, the interaction fails the pass bar.
